settlement_source: SPORTAWARD hierarchy: league/NCAA, the award body (Heisman Trust), ESPN, AP, The Athletic, SI, Fox, CBS, NBC, etc. Series metadata lists ESPN only.
settlement_variable: Recipient(s) of the College Football Heisman Trophy for the 2026-27 season as officially announced, documented at expiration time.
tie_handling: If 'Tie/Co-Winners' is listed it resolves Yes and all others No. Otherwise Yes pays $1/N tied participants, No pays 1 minus that. 'No Award Given' resolves Yes if listed and no award is given.
trading_close_vs_settlement: close_time 2027-01-01T15:00Z but expiration_time 2027-01-15T15:00Z. Rulebook says Last Trading Time = Expiration time, which conflicts with the earlier listed close_time (which controls in practice is unknown). settlement_timer 1800s. can_close_early=1.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Kalshi may open Market Outcome Review (Rule 7.1) at sole discretion; if no value, Kalshi sets payouts. Ineligible, non-finalist or withdrawn participants resolve No immediately. Revocation/vacation after expiration ignored. Leaks/media insufficient without Source Agency confirmation.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Market title 'Who will win Heisman Trophy?' has no season; rules_primary specifies 2026-2027.

close_time (2027-01-01) is 2 weeks before expiration_time (2027-01-15) while the rulebook equates last trading with expiration. The Heisman ceremony is normally in December (2026 date unverified), so the market may remain open after the real-world announcement or close before the official result is documented.
